summary: Authored a six-phase plan for the carried-figure authoring contract. Phase 1 re-derives every figure the plan carries from the research report (dogfooding the contract with inline CARRIED-UNVERIFIED marks); Phases 2-3 amend report-format.md with the full contract and point plan-format.md at it from Counts-are-hypotheses; Phase 4 is a measured decision gate (recall/precision/boundedness) on the narrow impossible-assertion detector, with Phase 5 conditional and its reasoned-exclusion contingency pre-written; Phase 6 is the acceptance sweep. Net format-document count stays at the measured pre-change value and both amendments are additive-only.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase, 4.25-hour plan amending report-format.md and plan-format.md with the carried-figure re-derive-or-mark contract, with a measured decision gate on the narrow internal-consistency detector.
